name: Haiti (Duvalier era, 1964–1986)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of black and red, with the coat of arms on a white panel in the centre.
history: Under the dictatorships of François and Jean-Claude Duvalier Haiti returned in 1964 to the black and red of Dessalines's 1804 flag, keeping the national arms on a white panel. The blue and red flag was restored on 26 February 1986, after the fall of Jean-Claude Duvalier.
